title: Small Drone Photos - Open Vegetation Protocol
author: Sabine St-Jean
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9zch72w
materials: Land the drone on the platform.

steps.title: Prepare Drone and Controller
steps.instruction: Power on the drone and controller, connect the controller to the CAT S41 cellphone, and launch the DJI Go 4 App.

substeps.instruction: Set Iso to 400 (lower this value if very sunny, or increase if darker)
Activate the Grid option to view center lines of the image

steps.title: Take Off and Position Drone
steps.instruction: Take off from the wood panel. Before capturing each image, ensure the camera is at a 90° angle (facing down), the plot or subplot is centered with visible sides, and the drone is stationary.

steps.title: Capture Plot Photo
steps.instruction: Fly at a sufficient height to capture the whole plot, ensuring the southwest corner of the grid is in the lower-left corner of the picture.

steps.title: Capture Subplot Photos
steps.instruction: Take photos of each subplot in numerical order, flying at a height where subplot sides are visible and as close to the vegetation as possible without wind causing vegetation movement/blurring.

steps.title: Export and Store Photos
steps.instruction: Download all original pictures to the cellphone and power down the equipment.

substeps.instruction: Navigate in DJI Go 4 App: Editor → Album → Photo to download pictures
Turn off the drone and controller and return them to their case

steps.title: Organize Photos on Cellphone
steps.instruction: Move the 10 pictures from the plot (1 plot photo and 9 subplot photos) from the DJI album in the cellphone Photo App to a new album titled with the plot name.

steps.title: Crop Images
steps.instruction: Crop each picture to limit the area outside the plot or subplot perimeter, ensuring the edges of the PVC pipes remain visible.

steps.title: Upload Plot Photo
steps.instruction: Upload the plot picture to Fulcrum under Vegetation Surveys: Herbs and Shrubs → Survey Event → Vegetation Photos: Plot.

steps.title: Upload Subplot Photos
steps.instruction: Upload subplot pictures to Fulcrum under Vegetation Surveys: Herbs and Shrubs → Cover Estimates: Subplot → Subplots → Record item [1 to 9] → Vegetation Photos: Subplot.
